_comment: Recorded native-versus-WASM browser divergences for the WASM parity gate. Each entry must state the fixture, the mechanism, the measured magnitude, and a tight bound so differences cannot silently grow.

components_i_cabinzone_dynamic.reason: ode23s transient with MoistAirSource/CabinZone evaluating HAPropsSI in the loop. rustprop uses std::f64::exp/ln/powf which resolves to glibc natively and compiler-rt/libm on wasm32; 1-ulp property variations integrate to a 6.66e-9 trajectory difference against the JDK/native baseline.
